---
title: "My Penguins"
format: html
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(palmerpenguins)
```

## Average bill length by species

```{r}
#| label: summary-table
penguins |>
  group_by(species) |>
  summarize(avg_bill_length_mm = mean(bill_length_mm, na.rm = TRUE))
```

## Bill length vs. depth

```{r}
#| label: bill-plot
#| warning: false
ggplot(penguins, aes(x = bill_length_mm, y = bill_depth_mm, color = species)) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(x = "Bill length (mm)", y = "Bill depth (mm)", color = "Species")
```
